title: Sparkly light bulb
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD84D'/>

  <!-- soft halo -->

  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='24' fill='#FFEF9E' opacity='0.35'/>

  <path d='M50 10 C33 10 22 23 22 39 C22 50 28 57 34 63 C37 66 38 69 38 73 L62 73 C62 69 63 66 66 63 C72 57 78 50 78 39 C78 23 67 10 50 10 Z'
